posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rift rumors, while fans continue to speculate about her pregnancy and a possible Bollywood comeback with 'Jee Le Zaraa.'

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit made history by selling out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden — the first Indian musician to do so. His 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' trailer and collaborations with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman have fans buzzing.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia turned heads at Cannes 2026 and is gearing up for her role in YRF's spy thriller 'Alpha' alongside Sharvari. She continues to dominate Bollywood's A-list calendar.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka returns to Indian cinema in SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, set for an April 2027 release. She's been sharing heartwarming family moments with daughter Malti and Nick Jonas.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK reunites with Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, and Jackie Shroff in 'King,' with Ranveer Singh confirmed in a cameo. Rumors of 'Main Hoon Na 2' with Farah Khan are also heating up.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo victory and shared stunning family vacation photos. Her pool party pics went viral as she continues to rule Bollywood's social scene.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is the second most-followed Indian actress on Instagram with 70M+ followers and recently splurged on a new Lamborghini. She rides high on the massive success of 'Stree 2.'

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for intense action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' due to her pregnancy, with a climactic sequence planned in South Africa.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces a FWICE ban over his abrupt exit from 'Don 3,' with Rs 45 crore in damages at stake. He visited Mysuru's Chamundeshwari Temple per a court directive and was spotted at Mumbai airport avoiding paparazzi.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at Cannes 2026 with a stunning swan-inspired couture ensemble and sapphire glam, marking her 24th appearance at the festival and cementing her status as Bollywood's eternal queen.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's new song 'Tujhko' from 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid Kapoor brings soft summer romance vibes. She's also been announced as Popeyes India's brand ambassador and teased a fierce new role in 'Mysaa.'

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's comeback film 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' dropped its trailer on May 25 showcasing her fierce avatar as a daughter-in-law. The action-packed film releases June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is filming 'Raaka' with Atlee while Deepika Padukone adjusts her action scenes around pregnancy. Post-Pushpa 2 hype continues as fans eagerly await his next blockbuster.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' song 'Hellallallo' with Janhvi Kapoor set screens on fire. He also apologized to Jasprit Bumrah after a viral identity mix-up during promotions. Film drops June 4.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel has locked a massive 55 crore North America and UK deal. The director praised NTR's intense physical transformation for the patriotic action thriller.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in 'Peddi,' set for a massive June 4 worldwide release with hundreds of premiere shows across the US and Canada. The CBFC censored explicit content from the film.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's 'Chand Mera Dil' crossed Rs 18 crore worldwide in its opening weekend but she's being trolled for a Bharatanatyam-inspired dance sequence. Father Chunky Panday defended it as fusion.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stole the show at sister Ishita's wedding in a stunning gold lehenga choli. She was also spotted in an Rs 85,000 saree with a backless blouse, setting major fashion goals.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik confirmed 'Krrish 4' is happening, while a throwback photo with Ameesha Patel from 'Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai' went viral. His new ponytail look inspired by SRK has fans swooning.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun teams up with dad David Dhawan for 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai,' a nostalgia-packed comedy releasing June 5. Anu Malik praised the film's classic 'Chunnari Chunnari' vibes.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya continues her US concert tour to packed venues. She recently shared an adorable update on son Devyaan, calling motherhood an 'overwhelming love' that changed her life forever.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' and addressed allegations of communal bias in Bollywood, speaking candidly about reduced opportunities in Hindi cinema.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' is locked for a June 19 release after clearing CBFC hurdles. Stars including Nayanthara and Atlee wished him as fans celebrated his legacy around his birthday.
